scoreCapture.description: When true, shows individual jury scores in score capture. When false, shows only the total score.

juryPortal.description: When true, jury members cannot see scores from other judges until they submit their own.

squadAutoAssign.description: Default criteria for automatic squad assignment (Riegeneinteilung). These values are loaded as defaults in the auto-assign dialog.

wifi.description: WiFi/WLAN settings for generating QR codes that judges can scan to connect to the competition network.
